item.description: To meet industrial expectations, engineering and engineering technology (ET) graduates are expected to possess the critical competencies of design, problem-solving, communication, and teamwork. item.description: Domestic wastewaters present high nitrogen levels due to the urea and ammonia, which are excreted into urine. item.title: Journal of the Arts and Special Education: Volume 6, Issue 1
DARTS: Ten Years of Advocacy, Collaboration, and Growth
item.description: The co-editors of the Journal of the Arts and Special Education (JASE) and past presidents reflect on the 10th anniversary of the Division of Visual and Performing Arts Education (DARTS). The editorial describes the history, founders, timeline, and the presidents of DARTS.

item.title: Unquestionably Undeniable: Meet and Remember Lachi
item.description: This interview-based article explores the career and advocacy of Lachi, a visually impaired musician and activist. Through personal reflections, she discusses identity, internalized ableism, and her role in co-founding RAMPD, highlighting how artistry and collective action advance accessibility, authentic representation, and disability visibility within the music industry.

item.title: A Systematic Review of Puppetry-based Social Skills Interventions for Children with Disabilities
item.description: Children with disabilities often require explicit social skills instruction. Underdeveloped social skills can impact a child’s ability to form relationships, communicate effectively, and navigate social situations. Puppetry has emerged as a promising and multifaceted tool for social skills instruction for children with disabilities. item.title: Theater is My Life: Creating Inclusive Spaces in Community Theater for Youth with Disabilities
item.description: This practitioners' guide provides 10 strategies for creating inclusive theater programs for youth with disabilities. The suggestions are based on experiences the author gained working with ACORN youth players. ACORN is an inclusive community theater that provides performance opportunities for all youth, but especially those with mental health struggles or high-incidence disabilities. Strategies focus on the different stages of theater production: planning, auditions, rehearsals, and performance
